comparison.objective: Pass a wafer carrier through an interlocked airlock and close both gates.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential gate operation and carrier transfer with the arms taking turns.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier reaches the left stop, stays on its lane, both gates finish shut, and the gates are never simultaneously open. No detailed spec version is present.
comparison.reason: This tests procedural interlock compliance and transfer sequencing, not mechanical tuning or force-controlled locking.
